question: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with which of the following companies for the PM SVANidhi scheme in February 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zomato**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As a part of Prime Minister Street Vendor’s AtmaNibhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) Scheme, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs has signed MoU with Company Zomato to join street food vendors on its food technology platform.
 
• This will give street food vendors online access to thousands of consumers and help these vendors grow their businesses.
 
• Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs launched the Mobile Application for PMSVANidhi se Samriddhi- Socio-economic profiling of PM SVANidhi beneficiaries and their families to link them to various Central Government Schemes.
 
• Quality Council of India- implementing partner for this program, partnered with MoHUA to develop this mobile application.
 
• The MoU with Zomato was exchanged between Sanjay Kumar, Joint Secretary, MoHUA and Mohit Sardana, Chief Operating Officer, Zomato.
 
• In the Present Covid Scenario, it is important to connect Street Food Vendors with technology enabled platforms to help them grow their business, thus helping them gain financially.
 
• Under the MoU, initially MoHUA and Zomato will run a pilot program by on-boarding 300 vendors across six cities namely – Bhopal, Ludhiana, Nagpur, Patna, Raipur, Vadodara. 
 
• The street vendors will be helped with PAN and fssai registration, training on technology/ partner app usage, menu digitization and pricing, hygiene and packaging best practices.
 
• This Scheme targets to benefit over 50 lakh Street Vendors.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA):__
 
• Ministry deals with laws and regulations relating to Housing and Urban affairs in India.
 
• Established in 1952.
 
• This Ministry announced the lists of smart cities, clean cities annually.
 
• Related Organizations: Central Public works department, Directorate of Estates, Printing Directorate.
 
• Schemes related : AMRUT, HRIDAY, Swachh Bharat Mission.
 
• Headquarters: New Delhi.
